title: A change moves a submodule whose clamp swaps its parameters, and adds a call with the old order

pr.title: Add the fade and balance settings
pr.description: Adds the fade time and the left-right balance to the mixer. Moves vendor/mathlib to its newest commit.

submodule.title: Put the range first in clamp

bugs.note: The new mathlib commit changes clamp to clamp(min, max, value). balance still passes the value first, so clamp gets min = raw, max = -50, and value = 50, and the balance is wrong for each slider value. Call clamp(-MAX_BALANCE, MAX_BALANCE, raw).

traps.why: fadeMs passes the range first, which is the order of the new mathlib commit. The call is correct.
volumeLevel moves to the new order of clamp together with the submodule commit. The call is correct.
